title: Stalk pullback comparison after nested open restriction
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $y\in Y$, and $U\subseteq V\subseteq Y$ opens containing $y$. Restriction from $V$ to $U$ followed by pullback along the map from $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ to $U$ is naturally isomorphic to pullback along the map to $V$. The equality of the underlying maps is [lem-pc-stalk-from-spec-subopen].
